exact_result: Genuine general-variety mixed E1 operator, raw mass V, normalized energy, target criterion and uniqueness reconstructed from BJ; exact existence conditional on EP. Independent actual affine FS determinant traces, nonflat normal-target slicing weights for global FS tests, Artinian trace base change, radial equality under explicit curve-current positivity, algebraic model-PL collars, upper-growth Runge-Hartogs distance regularization, direct entropy/support sequences, and nonnormal pole-order localization proved as drafts. Full geometrically unibranch singular envelopes, equation existence and onto normalization remain unproved.
concrete_gaps: For general corrected local convex data defined only on a tropical image, a compatible CLD-current positivity/ambient smoothing or independent curve slope proof is still needed. Radial equality is proved with continuous CLD-psh approximants after the specified extension, including explicit ambient-convex/actual FS inputs.

Arbitrary smooth weak upper-growth affine regularization and removable extension require the fully compatible bounded local mixed-measure construction, overlap independence, total mass, integration by parts, comparison and local/global domination; individual PL positivity does not establish those steps.

Rossi arbitrary analytic-neighborhood gluing and the split analytic-piece use in Wu 6.15 have not been shown to satisfy the narrower algebraic collar hypotheses. Locally constant integer degree localization, the gamma=1 case, local projection and the complete Runge induction remain to be reconstructed.

Wu 6.3/6.5 and the countable rational singular envelope base are therefore unproved. Arbitrary-cardinality and real-class singular envelope passage, unconditioned variational attainment, and onto PSH/E1/energy/operator normalization cannot be claimed.
